scope: Three real AEC Challenge scenarios, ten-second passthrough baseline; 48k is explicitly resampled interface coverage, not native fullband benchmark

verification_scorers.eer: known perfect, reversed, tied ROC cases, score-direction/order invariance and invalid inputs
verification_scorers.min_dcf: 100 seeded random score vectors with ties, independently enumerated thresholds, raw and normalized costs (200 comparisons)
verification_scorers.scope: Analytical scorer validation; no population speaker-verification EER benchmark claim

compatibility.initial_default_gpu_observation: Autotuned GPU execution varied by about 2.1e-5 on one repeated 48k output. Fixed DEFAULT convolution and deterministic compute removed the observed variation. NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 reduced CPU/GPU differences below 1e-6.
compatibility.determinism_limit: Observed repeated values, not a guarantee across hardware/drivers.
